fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects remote PowerShell sections by monitoring for wsmprovhost (WinRM host process) as a parent or child process (sign of an active PowerShell remote session).
fields.name: Remote PowerShell Session Host Process (WinRM)
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\wsmprovhost.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\wsmprovhost.exe"))
